notes.title: March Cat
notes.content:
We have corrected a number of errors in the text of the game and translation, and also added a guide to the workshop directly into the plot of the Cat.

Now, when reading the story, you can immediately find out how to add your story to the game.

By the way, there is a competition for the best spring modification in the Kotosphere group.

notes.title: Story contest
notes.content:
Hello to all the inhabitants of the Catsphere!

As promised, I'm launching a literary cat contest.

- Wait, wait, Total, are you sure this is a good idea?

Of course! After all, the conditions are simple to the point of outrage:
1. Subscribe to [url=https://vk.com/catsphere]Catsphere[/url];
2. Repost entries about the contest [url=https://vk.com/catsphere]from here [/url] or from the page of any of the judges;
3. In the period from January 1 to January 13, you need to throw in the offer [url=https://vk.com/catsphere]Catsphere[/url]your story about a cat;
4. The genre can be any, the theme too. There are only a couple of restrictions: the volume is up to 15,000 characters with spaces (well, so as not to be long read in articles), and the age rating is at least 12+, as low as possible.

The prize fund of the contest is currently 7000 rubles. If you want to replenish it with donations, write to the [url=https://vk.com/catsphere]public[/url], I will give the details.

After the end of the acceptance of the works, they will be published on the wall of the Catsphere and the audience voting will begin. How the shortlist will be compiled - I will keep it a secret for now in order to avoid fraud.

And after the people's will, our judicial board will take up the case.

Learn more about the rules of participation, judges and prizes [url=https://vk.com/wall-203847352_10]here[/url].
